how_to_apply: Apply online only at https://bsf.mha.gov.in; no other mode is accepted.
Complete One Time Registration with name, active mobile number and e-mail ID; Registration ID and password are sent to mobile and e-mail.
Log in, open the advertisement under 'online application' and click 'Apply Here'.
Fill the form and upload photograph, signature, thumb impression, NOC (Annexure-V) and certificates (Annexure-III and IV).
Pay the fee through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or nearest Common Service Centre; the payment portal fee is to be paid by all candidates.
Printout may be kept for own record; it is not to be sent to BSF.

content_sections.heading: How Will BSF Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Stage-I: Written Examination (CBT Mode) Stage-II: Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Documents Verification and Medical Examination CBT: one objective paper of 200 marks in 03:30 hrs, four subjects of 50 marks each PET is qualifying only; failure in one event leads to disqualification Detailed Medical Examination by Medical Boards of concerned CAPFs, with Review Medical Examination Tie in CBT resolved by date of birth (older higher), then alphabetical order of first name Final merit list prepared by Nodal Force; selected list uploaded on BSF website

content_sections.heading: BSF Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum 45% marks in each part and 50% in aggregate to qualify Relaxation of 5% marks for SC/ST Calculators and electronic gadgets not permitted Objection link on BSF website 2-3 days after CBT No re-evaluation or rechecking of scores

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Service cum eligibility certificate (Annexure-III) Undertaking (Annexure-IV) NOC from competent authority (Annexure-V) Photograph not more than 3 months old, without cap and spectacles Signature and thumb impression Originals of age proof, educational qualification, caste certificate and Medical Fitness Certificate at DV

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No change of exam centre will be considered No correction allowed after final submission No TA/DA for attending LDCE; period treated as leave Candidates on deputation/attachment apply through parent units for NOC and certificates Vacancies may increase or decrease due to administrative reasons

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BSF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 December 2026. Applications opened on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BSF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 1167 vacancies: 235 Sub Inspector (GD) - BSF, 377 Sub Inspector (GD) - CRPF, 125 Sub Inspector (GD) - SSB, 430 Sub Inspector (GD) - ITBP.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BSF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years (as on the closing date of submission of applications). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Metrix Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400 ) for Sub Inspector (GD) - BSF, Pay Metrix Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400 ) for Sub Inspector (GD) - CRPF, Pay Metrix Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400 ) for Sub Inspector (GD) - SSB, Pay Metrix Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400 ) for Sub Inspector (GD) - ITBP.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Degree from a recognized university or equivalent; serving Constables (GD), Constables (Tradesmen), Head Constables (GD), ASIs (GD) of BSF, CRPF, ITBP and ASI (GD) of SSB with four years regular service including basic training and a clean record. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Four years regular service including basic training. Minimum Good APAR grading of last five years (four years if only 4 years of service). Unblemished clean record of entire service until issue of offer of appointment. Medical category SHAPE-I; Low Medical Category applications not entertained.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates in Low Medical Category.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stage-I: Written Examination (CBT Mode). Stage-II: Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Documents Verification and Medical Examination. CBT: one objective paper of 200 marks in 03:30 hrs, four subjects of 50 marks each. PET is qualifying only; failure in one event leads to disqualification.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by BSF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BSF, CRPF, SSB, ITBP.
